title: First Community Parking District-funded sidewalk repair project happening in Downtown San Diego!
description:
The first Community Parking District-funded sidewalk repair is underway at 7th Ave and B St. in Downtown San Diego.

This sidewalk segment was previously in rough shape and is now under construction and ready for fresh and smooth concrete, thanks to funding collected from local parking meters.

Money from parking meters stays right there in the community where it is collected to fund infrastructure improvements like this.

#SanDiegoAtWork
